stories.title: US offers up to $20 million for tips on Iran's nuclear programme
stories.summary: The United States announced a reward of up to $20 million for information about Iran’s nuclear programme, with the State Department’s Rewards for Justice also offering possible relocation for the informant. The announcement follows former President Donald Trump’s claim that Iran’s nuclear facilities had been completely destroyed in a US‑Israel bombing campaign, a claim Iran denies, saying its programme is peaceful. The US military said it is forming a task force to restrict Iran’s movement of weapons and sanctioned material across its borders.
stories.why: The reward aims to generate intelligence that could clarify Iran’s nuclear activities and inform U.S. non‑proliferation policy.

stories.title: Gunman kills at least six in Krakow market square, three bodies found at his home
stories.summary: At least six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman, suspected of far‑right ties, drove into Krakow’s Main Market Square shortly before 15:00 local time and opened fire from his vehicle. Police later searched the suspect’s residence and discovered three bodies. The incident occurred in Poland’s second‑largest city and involved random shooting of pedestrians.
stories.why: The attack underscores the threat of extremist violence in a major European city and raises public‑safety concerns.

stories.title: Quebec confirms cow infected with rabies amid ongoing raccoon outbreak
stories.summary: Quebec health officials have confirmed that a cow tested positive for rabies, adding a new case to the province’s current raccoon‑rabies outbreak. The discovery shows that the wildlife‑borne virus continues to spread and can affect domestic livestock, prompting ongoing surveillance and precautionary measures.
stories.why: This matters because it could expand treatment options or demonstrate a clinically meaningful new medical technology.

stories.title: Concurrent Gainers: 9 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
stories.summary: Amid this broad-based rally, around 45 stocks from the BSE 200 index advanced in all five consecutive sessions from November 2 to 6. Of these, we shortlisted 9 stocks that consistently gained throughout the period, delivering cumulative returns ranging from 15% to 20%.
stories.why: This can affect market expectations, company valuations, sector sentiment or capital flows.

stories.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
stories.summary: Crusoe, an eight-year-old, Denver-based data center developer recently valued at $30.9 billion , confirmed Friday it has sold an unfinished data center project in southeastern Wyoming to Google. Google did not disclose how much it paid Crusoe for the unfinished project, but it announced plans to invest $17 billion to develop the data center campus.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
